instruction: Open gamma_log.txt from Documents and count the case-sensitive whole-word occurrences of agent. Save only the decimal count in Documents\agent_count.txt, then open the output and verify it.
_comments: E3 held-out evaluation variant. Never use it for a human demonstration or Compiler input.

command:
from pathlib import Path; source=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\gamma_log.txt'); source.write_text('agent agent agent
Agent stays capitalized
agents is plural
agent signal agent
agent agent agent agent
one agent remains
agent agent agent
', encoding='utf-8'); Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\agent_count.txt').unlink(missing_ok=True)
from pathlib import Path; p=Path(r'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\agent_count.txt'); print('true' if p.is_file() and p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').strip() == '13' else 'false', end='')
